newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon unit completes Korean project.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon unit completes Korean project.

text.p: Raytheon Co unit Raytheon Engineers & Constructors, the prime contractor for a $200 million Korean petrochemical plant, said Tuesday that the project sets an industry record for fastest completion among facilities of similar size.

Raytheon Engineers said it completed the Yukong No.2 Paraxylene Facility in Ulsan, Korea, 18 months after it started the project and six months ahead of the normal time required to complete a project of comparable scope. The plant is designed to produce 300,000 tons of paraxylene annually. Paraxylene is a key component in the production of plastic bottles and synthetic fibers.
Raytheon Engineers said the Korean contract was worth approximately $37 million to the company.
Raytheon Engineers, one of four business segments of Raytheon Co, is a full-service engineering and construction firm serving clients worldwide.
Raytheon Co is an international high technology company that also operates in the commercial and defense electronics, aircraft and major appliances industries.
